selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods for the combined Svalbard and Jan Mayen identity; both territories remain parts of Norway throughout the modelled period.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Norway-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No tennis federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Constitutional or territorial status is context only, not direct sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
